```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s07_ROH/"
```

# Load gt

```{r}
malagasy <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_clean.gt")
count_loci(malagasy)
```

# Separate populations and save to plink

```{r}
malagasy <- malagasy %>% group_by(population)
merina <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Merina")
sakalava <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Sakalava_Tsimihety")
betsileo <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Betsileo")
betsimisaraka <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Betsimisaraka")
diego <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Diego")
vezo <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Vezo")
mikea <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Mikea")
temoro <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Temoro")

# Load fastmixture Q matrix
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean.gt")
# subset to only malagasy
all_malagasy <- c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Diego", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro")
# tidy with the gt
tidyq <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1), data = mad_bor_g1000_sum)
malagasyq <- tidyq %>% filter(population %in% all_malagasy)
#subset the malagasyq dataframe to only the "Merina"
merina <- malagasyq %>% filter(population == "Merina")
# group the merina
merina$group <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "Social group A", "Social group B")
merinaA <- merina %>% filter(group == "Social group A")
merinaB <- merina %>% filter(group == "Social group B")
```

# Read the outputs

```{r}
# Define a function to process a single BED file
process_bed_file <- function(bed_file_path) {
  # Read the whole file into R
  bed_data <- read.table(bed_file_path, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Find rows that contain individual name and population (e.g. lines with 'name =')
  individual_lines <- grep("name=", bed_data$V2)
  
  # Split the data by these individual lines
  individual_data_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(individual_lines)) {
    # Define the start and end of the section for each individual
    start_line <- individual_lines[i] + 1
    end_line <- ifelse(i < length(individual_lines), individual_lines[i+1] - 1, nrow(bed_data))
    
    # Extract data for this individual
    individual_data <- bed_data[start_line:end_line, ]
    
    individual_name <- bed_data$V3[individual_lines[i]]
    individual_data_list[[individual_name]] <- individual_data
  }
  
  # Return the list of data frames, one per individual
  return(individual_data_list)
}

bed_files <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "_garlic.roh.bed", full.names = TRUE)
all_individual_data <- lapply(bed_files, process_bed_file)

```


```{r}
all_individual_data <- unlist(all_individual_data, recursive = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Initialize an empty data frame to store summarized results
roh_summary <- data.frame(Individual = character(),
                          short = integer(),
                          medium = integer(),
                          long = integer(),
                          sum_short = integer(),
                          sum_medium = integer(),
                          sum_long = integer(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)



for (ind_name in names(all_individual_data)) {  
  # Get the individual's data
  ind_data <- all_individual_data[[ind_name]]
  
  sum_short <- 0
  sum_medium <- 0
  sum_long <- 0
  
  ind_data$V5 <- as.numeric(ind_data$V5)
  
  sum_short <- sum_short + sum(ind_data$V5[ind_data$V4 == "A"], na.rm = TRUE)
  sum_medium <- sum_medium + sum(ind_data$V5[ind_data$V4 == "B"], na.rm = TRUE)
  sum_long <- sum_long + sum(ind_data$V5[ind_data$V4 == "C"], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Count occurrences of A, B, and C in V4
  counts <- table(ind_data$V4)
  
  # Extract counts safely (0 if missing)
  short_count <- ifelse("A" %in% names(counts), counts["A"], 0)
  medium_count <- ifelse("B" %in% names(counts), counts["B"], 0)
  long_count <- ifelse("C" %in% names(counts), counts["C"], 0)
  
  # Add to summary data frame
  roh_summary <- rbind(roh_summary, data.frame(Individual = ind_name, 
                                               short = as.integer(short_count), 
                                               medium = as.integer(medium_count), 
                                               long = as.integer(long_count),
                                              sum_short = as.integer(sum_short),
                                              sum_medium = as.integer(sum_medium),
                                              sum_long = as.integer(sum_long)))
}
 
# Reshape the data into long format for ggplot2
roh_long <- roh_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("short", "medium", "long"),
               names_to = "Run_type",
               values_to = "Count")%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sum_short, sum_medium, sum_long), 
               names_to = "Sum_type", 
               values_to = "Length") %>%
  mutate(Sum_type = sub("sum_", "", Sum_type)) %>%  # Remove "sum_" prefix
  filter(Run_type == Sum_type) %>%
  select(-Sum_type) 


```

```{r}
ggplot(roh_long, aes(x = Individual, y = Count, fill = Run_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +  # Stack bars instead of dodging
  labs(title = "Number of Runs by Individual",
       x = "Individual ID",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Run Type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# match the roh_long$Individual and malagasy$id
matches <- match(roh_long$Individual, malagasy$id)
# add $population to roh_long
roh_long$Population <- malagasy$population[matches]
# if $Individual is in merinaA$id, add "merina_a" to roh_long$Population
roh_long$Population <- ifelse(roh_long$Individual %in% merinaA$id, "Merina_A", roh_long$Population)
# if $Individual is in merinaB$id, add "merina_b" to roh_long$Population
roh_long$Population <- ifelse(roh_long$Individual %in% merinaB$id, "Merina_B", roh_long$Population)
```

```{r}
ggplot(roh_long, aes(x = Population, y = Count, fill = Run_type)) +
```
